name: github.com/json-iterator/go
scope: RFC 8259 JSON text decoded into interface{}
family_note: Own byte Iterator implementation; it does not delegate decoding to encoding/json. It imports encoding/json types only for json.Number, json.RawMessage, and Marshaler/Unmarshaler compatibility.

name: github.com/tidwall/gjson
license_evidence: LICENSE in pinned Go module zip
input_api: gjson.ValidBytes([]byte) then gjson.ParseBytes([]byte); Result.ForEach traverses objects and arrays
scope: RFC 8259 JSON text validated as a complete local byte slice, then traversed through GJSON Result nodes; observed control subset
family_note: GJSON owns its byte/character scanner in gjson.go. ParseBytes assumes well-formed JSON, so the harness first invokes its own ValidBytes; the full Result tree is then visited with ForEach. It does not call encoding/json to parse input. The package serves JSON path queries, so its adoption count is not evidence of general-purpose decoding use.

name: github.com/ugorji/go/codec
license_evidence: LICENSE in pinned Go module zip
scope: Local JSON byte slice decoded through codec.JsonHandle into untyped Go values; observed valid control subset
family_note: The JsonHandle selects go-codec own JSON reader; JSON-specific files under codec/json.* are instrumented and mapped to AFL feedback. The package also implements binc, CBOR, MessagePack and simple, so its Imported by metric is total package adoption and does not measure JSON-specific use.

name: github.com/goccy/go-json
scope: RFC 8259 JSON text decoded into interface{}
family_note: Own type-compiled decoder in internal/decoder that scans the byte slice itself; it does not call encoding/json or json-iterator to decode. It imports encoding/json, encoding/json/v2, and encoding/json/jsontext for error, json.Number, and Unmarshaler/UnmarshalJSONFrom interoperability.

name: github.com/buger/jsonparser
license_evidence: LICENSE in pinned Go module zip
input_api: jsonparser.Get([]byte) plus ObjectEach and ArrayEachErr over local byte slices
scope: Local JSON byte slice parsed by recursive ObjectEach/ArrayEachErr and scalar conversion; this path-query API is not claimed to validate an entire arbitrary JSON document
family_note: The pinned jsonparser parser.go and escape.go implement their own byte scanner and JSON value extraction. The harness recursively visits all object and array values in the two controls, but Get is a path parser and not a full-document validator. No encoding/json decoder is used.

name: github.com/valyala/fastjson
license_evidence: LICENSE in pinned Go module zip
input_api: fastjson.Parser.ParseBytes([]byte) over one complete local JSON byte slice
scope: Full local JSON document into fastjson.Value tree, recursively traversed to observe decoded structures and values on both controls; only the observed subset is verified
family_note: parser.go implements its own JSON tokenizer and Value tree. No encoding/json decoder is used in the parse harness; reporter uses encoding/json only for summary receipt serialization.

name: github.com/bytedance/sonic
license_evidence: LICENSE in pinned Go module zip
input_api: sonic.Unmarshal([]byte, *any) over one complete local JSON byte slice
scope: Complete local JSON document decoded into untyped Go values, then summarized; both observed valid controls verified
family: Sonic optimized arm64 decoder: Go optdec over native NEON parser
family_note: On linux/arm64 with Go 1.27.1, sonic.go and decoder_native.go build tags select Sonic. internal/decoder/api/decoder_arm64.go routes decodeImpl to optdec.Decode; optdec.Parser.parse calls native.ParseWithPadding implemented by NEON assembly. The harness rejects sonic.APIKind != UseSonicJSON. Go source coverage and AFL bridge instrument optdec Go source, not NEON assembly instructions.

name: github.com/segmentio/encoding/json
license_evidence: LICENSE in pinned Go module zip; pkg.go.dev license MIT
input_api: json.Unmarshal([]byte, *any) over one complete local JSON byte slice
scope: Complete local JSON document decoded into untyped Go values, then summarized; both observed valid controls verified
family: segmentio/encoding/json own Go parser (parseValue + reflection codec)
family_note: Unmarshal calls Parse(b, x, 0); decoding into *any goes through decoder.decodeInterface, which tokenizes with the package's own parseValue in parse.go and builds map[string]interface{} / []interface{} values in decode.go. The package imports encoding/json only for shared types (RawMessage, Number, error and Marshaler aliases) and for Compact/HTMLEscape/Indent, which the harness does not call.

name: github.com/mailru/easyjson/jlexer
license_evidence: LICENSE in pinned Go module zip; pkg.go.dev license MIT
input_api: jlexer.Lexer{Data: []byte}.Interface() over one complete local JSON byte slice, then Lexer.Consumed() and Lexer.Error()
scope: Complete local JSON document decoded into untyped Go values by Lexer.Interface, then summarized; both observed valid controls verified
family_note: jlexer is the lexer that easyjson-generated code calls; the harness uses its documented generic Lexer.Interface method instead of generated code. Interface tokenizes with jlexer's own FetchToken/fetchString/fetchNumber scanner and builds map[string]interface{} / []interface{} values; Consumed rejects non-whitespace trailing data. The package imports encoding/json only for the json.Number type (JsonNumber) and json.Valid inside SkipRecursive, neither of which the harness path calls. The Imported by count is for the jlexer package, which is mostly imported by easyjson-generated code, not by callers of Interface.
